question: An engineer must perform a configuration backup of an existing Cisco UCS Manager environment. The backup file must contain all vNIC, vHBA, and service profile template settings. Also, the engineer must validate the backup before import and requires an XML output format. Which backup type must be used to meet these requirements?
theory: A backup that must include vNIC, vHBA, and service profile template settings — logical objects, not user/role or full binary state — and needs to be XML (so it can be validated/reviewed before import) points to a Logical Configuration backup, which is exactly the XML export scoped to service profiles, templates, pools, and policies. Full State is binary and not reviewable in the same way, and System/All Configuration either omit these logical objects or bundle in unrelated system settings, making Logical Configuration the precise match. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 14 — UCS Configuration Management, Logical Configuration Backup)
